_comment: Login B (1.1.0 multi-login): a followers_only daemon for a second Tradovate login. No main account and no Soup publisher; Soup routes answer 409. Empty followers = connected and ready, no account assigned. master_kill_switch_file is login A's main ENTRIES-DISABLED (read only). The daemon reads its own order token from token_env (logins/b/tvbridge.env) and accepts its read-only token from read_token_env for GET /login and /health only. Each peer is read with that peer's READ token (logins/peers.env holds only TVBRIDGE_READ_TOKEN_<ID>). peer_hedge_scope "configured" (default): only peer accounts assigned as main or follower on their login count; "all": every visible account. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
